state.description: Fresh local Sandbox DAO deployed from source-built base WASM. Root calls new(), so FactoryInfo.factory_id is root; root then calls update(candidate bytes), exercising the authorized configured-factory branch. A separate recipient verifies the post-upgrade transfer.
state.notACapture: This is not captured public-chain state and must never be labelled as such.

configuredFactory.note: Not production factory behavior and not governance UpgradeSelf.

committedRes.warning: Stale in the PR/merge; do not use as candidate.

toolchain.sandboxRustEnv: NEAR_SANDBOX_BIN_PATH must be the executable FILE for near-sandbox-utils 0.13
toolchain.sandboxNodeEnv: NODE_SANDBOX_BIN_DIR (or Node-side NEAR_SANDBOX_BIN_PATH) must be the DIRECTORY; do not reuse the Rust file value

operation.upgrade: root calls update(raw candidate_wasm) as the persisted configured factory -> deploy candidate -> migrate()
operation.postUpgrade: act_proposal(id, VoteApprove, same Transfer kind) signed by root
assertions: old proposal raw view has InProgress status and no last_actions_log
candidate code bytes equal built candidate
final proposal status Approved and root vote persisted
separate recipient balance increases by exactly the proposal amount
bounded finality barrier reaches the highest transaction/receipt block before each final view
partial or failed runs persist stage plus completed raw transaction/receipt receipts
standalone Node CJS runner marks passed only after all assertions pass
